import unittest.mock
import httpx
import pytest
from src import bankclient


def test_balance_v2_payload_structure():
    req = httpx.Request("GET", "https://bank.test/accounts/checking/balance")
    v2_response = httpx.Response(200, json={"balance": {"value": 54321, "currency": "USD"}}, request=req)
    with unittest.mock.patch("httpx.get", return_value=v2_response) as mock_get:
        result = bankclient.balance("checking")
        assert result == 54321
        mock_get.assert_called_once_with("https://bank.test/accounts/checking/balance")


def test_transfer_v2_request_payload():
    req = httpx.Request("POST", "https://bank.test/transfers")
    v2_response = httpx.Response(
        200,
        json={"id": "tx-999", "source": "checking", "destination": "savings", "amount_cents": 2500, "refunded": False},
        request=req,
    )
    with unittest.mock.patch("httpx.post", return_value=v2_response) as mock_post:
        res = bankclient.transfer("checking", "savings", 2500)
        assert res["amount_cents"] == 2500
        assert mock_post.call_count == 1
        call_kwargs = mock_post.call_args[1]
        assert call_kwargs.get("json") == {
            "source": "checking",
            "destination": "savings",
            "amount": {"value": 2500, "currency": "USD"},
        }


def test_refund_v2_endpoint():
    req = httpx.Request("POST", "https://bank.test/refunds/create")
    v2_response = httpx.Response(
        200,
        json={"id": "tx-123", "source": "checking", "destination": "savings", "amount_cents": 100, "refunded": True},
        request=req,
    )
    with unittest.mock.patch("httpx.post", return_value=v2_response) as mock_post:
        res = bankclient.refund("tx-123")
        assert res["refunded"] is True
        mock_post.assert_called_once_with(
            "https://bank.test/refunds/create",
            json={"transaction_id": "tx-123"},
        )
